name: Inspiring Banner
body:
Your troops are encouraged by your brave words while they follow your banner.

Prerequisite(s): Banner and inspiring command class features.

Benefit(s): Morale bonuses on attacks and saving throws against fear provided by your inspire courage bardic performance stack with those granted by your banner ability.
